title: How Off-Plan Investors Make Money: It's All About Risk
seoTitle: How Off-Plan Investors Make Money: It's About Risk
description: Off-plan profit comes from the gap between early risk and late certainty. How investors buy at presale prices and sell when the building is visible.
answer: Off-plan investors profit from the difference in risk tolerance between early and late buyers. They buy during presale, when risk is highest and prices lowest, then assign the contract once the building stands and buyers can visit units, when risk is low and prices are higher.
body:
How do investors make money with off-plan property? It comes down to one thing: how much risk each buyer is willing to take.

## The start: high risk, low price

At the very beginning, a development is a risky investment. There is a site, a plan and a promise. Nobody knows for sure if it will be built on time, or at all. Because of that risk, early buyers get access to the lowest prices, a kind of club price for investing alongside the developer in the presale phase.

## The end: low risk, high price

Typically 12 to 36 months later, the building stands. Now things change. Buyers can visit. They can walk into a unit, choose the one they like, and see the view from the window with their own eyes. Selling those units becomes much easier.

The counterpart is that the price is now much higher. Buyers pay more because they take almost no risk.

## The profit is in the gap

The early investor assigns their contract to one of these late buyers. Their profit is the difference between the price they paid in the presale phase and the price the late buyer is happy to pay for certainty.

## Two buyers, two risk profiles

The early buyer accepts uncertainty in exchange for a lower price. The late buyer pays a premium to avoid uncertainty. Both are making a rational choice. The off-plan market works because both kinds of buyer exist.
takeaways: Early off-plan buyers take the most risk and get the lowest prices.
Once the building stands and can be visited, prices rise because risk falls.
Investors profit by assigning the contract to a later, more cautious buyer.
The gap between early risk and late certainty is where the money is.
faq: The period when a developer sells units before or early in construction, usually at the lowest prices the project will have.
Why are completed units more expensive than presale units?
Because buyers can see and visit them. The risk that the building will not be finished, or will look different, is gone.
Is off-plan investing guaranteed to make money?
No. Delays, a falling market or a developer failing can erase the profit or put your deposits at risk.
